mounting_geometry.cup_to_frame_support: Two side ears only; sleeve R30.1..32 does not touch frame R32.5..38.

access.method: Each exact probe/swept BREP is checked vs each object, per-solid Boolean intersection after AABB pruning. Volume >1e-4 mm3 reported as penetration; nominal contact allowed.
conditions: HEAD03 all-open position, de-energized no-load assembly; no powered maintenance.
Rear OD8 probe from Z-80 to-15.35; own nut and bolt intentionally excluded only from full-cylinder test. Annular OD8/ID4.7 probe is additional space check, not selected socket geometry.
Front OD3 cylindrical driver-shaft probe from Z4.1 to64.1; driver handle, actual tip and accessibility from outside the complete skinned product not qualified.
Nut circumcircle-annulus R2/cos30, boreD2 from Z-50 to-15.35 contains arbitrary nut spin and axial approach; simplified threaded interface excluded.
Front-removal translation is +60mm in Z, sequentially excluding already removed parts only. Complete M2 screw shank/head swept before bezel removal.

GH12 reference moves with PCB only after connector cable has been disconnected and released, or an adequately released service loop established separately. No cable/strain-relief/latch actuation model is included.
If GH cannot be unlatched in place, service the entire optical-frame subassembly on bench; removing that subassembly is an additional unverified route, not proven by the PCB sweep.

motion_formula_review.reviewed_method: Distance is 1-Lipschitz in Hausdorff motion; nearest endpoint is at most half interval away. min(endpoint distances)-V*half angular interval is a valid lower bound.
motion_formula_review.rotor: Unit closing axes; maximum perpendicular radius of all AABB corners bounds the complete solid, not just vertices sampled from the solid.
motion_formula_review.P16_reason: L²=D²+a²+2Da sin(q-phase), phase68 and q0..122 => cosine positive; Lmin atq0. |Lprime|<=a and |betaprime|<=a(D+a)/Lmin². All native envelope corners lie within149.084925<160mm of base at max extension, so 26+160*beta is valid.
motion_formula_review.containing_obstacle: All new CD geometry lies in root closed union R32/Z-11..1.75, ears X+-38.25/Y+-4, and two R2.5/Z-17.9..4.1 bolt cylinders. Modified old frame only loses two holes; frame clearance inherits HEAD03 evidence, not the central obstacle alone.

LP5860_source.proposal: Centers(+/-10,+5), six-mm square package/land planning boxes Z-4.1..-3. Optional10x10 XY circuit-placement reserves are not routed passives.

limitations: Geometric fit only, no net assignment/routing or LED current/thermal approval.
Leave board perimeter R28..30 free of backside components; PCB underside touches seat directly, so if cup is conductive require copper/via electrical keepout or separately engineered insulation.
Current circular PCB has no positive angular key; set assembly GH orientation explicitly. Friction/preload or an optional indexing feature requires later verification.
GH tail/12 wires and positive latch actuation need their own mechanical service path.

reproduction.instruction: Extract python_script to a scratch .py file and run with CadQuery runtime: python script.py /absolute/repository /absolute/scratch-output. It reads source files only and writes access3525.json in scratch.

# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-NC-4.0

from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,math,itertools,hashlib
import numpy as np
import cadquery as cq
root=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'engineering'))
import central_display_mount01 as cd
from screen_integrated_collisions import named_step
from studies.link_interface_tools import check,cache
from build_link56_study import face_contact
w=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve();w.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source=root/'engineering/central_display_mount01.py'
# Read-only independent hypothetical transform from current baseline. No repository mutation.
t=source.read_text().replace('for x in [-35.,35.]:','for x in [-35.25,35.25]:')
ns={'__file__':str(source),'__name__':'independent_candidate'};exec(compile(t,'cd_candidate3525','exec'),ns)
sh=named_step(root/'engineering/generated/head-integrated-03/HEAD-INTEGRATED03-open.step');p,rows=ns['build'](sh['removable_optical_frame'])
fixed={n:s for n,s in sh.items() if n not in ['removable_optical_frame','display_including_candidate_GH_keepout']};fixed.update(p)
cs={n:cache(s) for n,s in fixed.items()}
r={'script_hash':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'hypothetical_edit':'none if root MOUNT_X=35.25; otherwise only two build loops shifted; no repository file edit','state':'HEAD03 open; complete named solids plus new CD','checks':[]}
def against(name,s,exclude=[]):
 c=cache(s);hits=[];checks=0;booleans=0
 for n,k in cs.items():
  if n in exclude:continue
  z=check(c,k);checks+=1;booleans+=z['boolean_count']
  if z['events']:hits.append({'id':n,**z})
 d={'name':name,'object_pairs':checks,'booleans':booleans,'hits':hits};r['checks'].append(d);print(name,len(hits),'hits',flush=True)
# Rear tool must reach around nut, not just touch its back. An annular driving section OD8/ID4.7
# goes from z-80 to rear washer z-15.35; nominal nut's Dcorner4.619 stays inside bore.
for side,x in [('L',-35.25),('R',35.25)]:
 tool=cd.C(4,64.65,(x,0,-80),(0,0,1),4.7)
 against(side+'_rear_OD8_ID4.7_tool_to_nut_flats',tool)
 # Full outer cylinder proves a bounded socket approach envelope after excluding its intended nut/bolt mates.
 against(side+'_rear_full_OD8_space_probe',cd.C(4,64.65,(x,0,-80),(0,0,1)),[f'CD01-{side}-M2x20-envelope',f'CD01-{side}-M2-nut-envelope'])
 # Circumcircle annulus continuously contains all hex-nut rotations and rear axial translations.
 against(side+'_nut_translation_and_spin_containing_annulus',cd.C(2/math.cos(math.pi/6),34.65,(x,0,-50),(0,0,1),2),[f'CD01-{side}-M2x20-envelope',f'CD01-{side}-M2-nut-envelope'])
 # Generic cylinder from head top forward for hex-driver shaft; caller-selected envelope only.
 tool=cd.C(1.5,60,(x,0,4.1),(0,0,1))
 against(side+'_front_OD3_shaft_60mm',tool)
 sweep=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-50).center(x,0).polygon(6,4/math.cos(math.pi/6)).extrude(34.65).val().cut(cd.C(1,40,(x,0,-51),(0,0,1)))
 against(side+'_nut_rear_insert_sweep',sweep,[f'CD01-{side}-M2x20-envelope',f'CD01-{side}-M2-nut-envelope'])
 print('washer area',side,face_contact(p['CD01-optical-frame'],p[f'CD01-{side}-rear-washer'],[x,0,-15],[0,0,1])['shared_planar_face_area_mm2'],flush=True)
# Continuous +Z translation sweeps; excluding successively removed pieces only. Use exact extrusion
# of z-prismatic XY profiles; intersections at intended start/end contact do not count as volume.
cup=p['CD01-cup'];bezel=p['CD01-bezel']
# Bezel has fixed XY profile, extrude its bottom face polygon union from .25 to61.75 by fuse translations/linear prism.
from OCP.BRepPrimAPI import BRepPrimAPI_MakePrism
from OCP.gp import gp_Vec
zfaces=[f for f in bezel.Faces() if abs(f.Center().z-.25)<1e-6 and abs(f.normalAt().z)>0.999]
bezel_sweep=cd.union([cq.Shape(BRepPrimAPI_MakePrism(f.wrapped,gp_Vec(0,0,61.5)).Shape()) for f in zfaces])
bolts=[n for n in p if 'M2x20' in n or 'front-washer' in n]
against('bezel_front_remove_60mm',bezel_sweep,['CD01-bezel']+bolts)
# Window disk front removal while bezel+front hardware removed.
against('window_front_remove_60mm',cd.C(29.9,60.75,(0,0,-.5),(0,0,1)),['CD01-window','CD01-bezel']+bolts)
# Then ring spacer.
against('spacer_front_remove_60mm',cd.C(29.9,61.5,(0,0,-2),(0,0,1),57),['CD01-window','CD01-bezel','CD01-insulating-spacer']+bolts)
# PCB + LED package front removal; GH can remain on PCB, lead disconnection/slack is outside model.
exclude=['CD01-PCB-outline','CD01-GH12-mated-reference','CD01-window','CD01-bezel','CD01-insulating-spacer']+bolts+[n for n in p if n.startswith('CD01-LED')]
against('PCB_front_remove_60mm',cd.C(30,61,(0,0,-3),(0,0,1)),exclude)
against('GH12_front_remove_with_PCB_60mm',cd.B(-9.475,9.475,-19.8,-11.05,-7.45,57),exclude)
# Candidate package and 10x10 placement reserves, not circuit routed/thermal qualification.
# Bolt removal after rear nut/washer have been removed; complete shaft and head translation union.
for side,x in [('L',-35.25),('R',35.25)]:
 sweep=cd.C(1,80,(x,0,-17.9),(0,0,1)).fuse(cd.C(1.9,62,(x,0,2.1),(0,0,1)))
 against(side+'_complete_bolt_front_remove_60mm',sweep,[f'CD01-{side}-M2x20-envelope',f'CD01-{side}-M2-nut-envelope',f'CD01-{side}-rear-washer'])
# Current-source actual contact areas after 35.25 change.
r['contacts']=[]
for a,b,z in [('CD01-cup','CD01-PCB-outline',-3),('CD01-PCB-outline','CD01-insulating-spacer',-2),('CD01-insulating-spacer','CD01-window',-.5),('CD01-window','CD01-bezel',.25),('CD01-cup','CD01-bezel',.25),('CD01-cup','CD01-optical-frame',-11)]:
 r['contacts'].append(dict(a=a,b=b,**face_contact(p[a],p[b],[0,0,z],[0,0,1])))
for side,x in [('L',-35.25),('R',35.25)]:
 for a,b,z in [(f'CD01-{side}-M2x20-envelope',f'CD01-{side}-front-washer',2.1),(f'CD01-{side}-front-washer','CD01-bezel',1.75),('CD01-optical-frame',f'CD01-{side}-rear-washer',-15),(f'CD01-{side}-rear-washer',f'CD01-{side}-M2-nut-envelope',-15.35)]:
  r['contacts'].append(dict(a=a,b=b,**face_contact(p[a],p[b],[x,0,z],[0,0,1])))
r['pcb']={} 
for side,x in [('L',-10),('R',10)]:
 for width in [6,10]:
  s=cd.B(x-width/2,x+width/2,5-width/2,5+width/2,-4.1,-3)
  rad=max(math.hypot(a,b) for a,b in itertools.product([x-width/2,x+width/2],[5-width/2,5+width/2]))
  r['pcb'][f'LP5860_{side}_{width}mm']={'bbox':cd.bb(s),'rmax':rad,'R28_margin':28-rad,'allocation_cut_volume':s.cut(cd.C(28,7,(0,0,-10),(0,0,1))).Volume(),'GH_gap':s.distance(p['CD01-GH12-mated-reference'])}
(w/'access3525.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print('DONE',flush=True)
